name: you-up
title: You Up?
description: Monitor your websites, APIs, servers, and cron jobs from Raycast: macOS menu bar status, Monitors, Incidents, Acknowledge, Snooze, and AI tools. Requires a You Up? account and API token.
author: frenzyfunky

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Your You Up? API token (uup_api_...), created under Organization Settings -> API Tokens at https://app.uup.dev. Read-only tokens view status, Monitors, and Incidents. Full tokens also Acknowledge, Snooze, Pause, and Resume.

commands.name: monitors
commands.title: Monitors
commands.subtitle: You Up?
commands.description: View Monitors across your Projects, inspect 30-day uptime and Check details, Acknowledge open Incidents, Snooze alerts, and Pause or Resume Monitors

commands.name: incidents
commands.title: Incidents
commands.subtitle: You Up?
commands.description: View open and recent Incidents, inspect multi-location outage evidence, and Acknowledge, Snooze, or Resolve Incidents with one keystroke

commands.name: status-menu-bar
commands.title: Menu Bar Status
commands.subtitle: You Up?
commands.description: Keep an eye on open Incidents and degraded Monitors from the macOS menu bar

tools.name: get-status
tools.title: Get Current Status
tools.description: Check what is currently down, degraded, or open across every Project your You Up? API token reaches

tools.name: list-monitors
tools.title: List Monitors
tools.description: List Monitors in You Up? with their current status, target, Checks, and 30-day uptime percentage

tools.name: list-incidents
tools.title: List Incidents
tools.description: List open or resolved Incidents in You Up?, or inspect where a specific Incident stopped across locations

tools.name: acknowledge-incident
tools.title: Acknowledge Incident
tools.description: Acknowledge an open Incident in You Up? so repeat alerts stop while recovery alerts remain active

tools.name: snooze-check
tools.title: Snooze Check Alerts
tools.description: Snooze alerts for a Check in You Up? until a specified duration passes while monitoring continues

ai.instructions: You Up? is an uptime monitoring service. Always start with get-status when the user asks whether everything is up or what is currently broken. When listing Monitors or Incidents without a projectId, the tools automatically inspect all Projects reachable by the token. Never guess Monitor, Check, or Incident IDs; look them up with get-status, list-monitors, or list-incidents first.
